sections.overview: Varadi Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.reference_sahasrayogam:
It is also known as Varadi Kashay, Varadi kashayam, Varadi Kasayam etc. 
 Varadi Kashayam is traditional herbal formulation used in Ayurveda for the treatment of urinary disorders, skin diseases and obesity. It has capacity to correct the digestion and metabolism. 
 The meaning of ‘Vara’ is ‘great’ and Kashaya refers to water decoction or herbal tea.
sections.ingredients:
Triphala – (Amla – Emblica officinalis , Haritaki – Terminalia chebula and Vibhitaki –   Terminalia bellirica) 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Loha patra – Iron (Herbal processed Iron foils are kept dipped in the Kashaya for a few days.) A few companies add Loha bhasma (medicated iron ash powder) to it, in place of iron foils) 
 Haridra – Curcuma longa 
 Water 

 How to Make? 
 All above mentioned ingredients are immersed in water overnight then next morning, heat it by adding water into it till it is reduced to 1/4th by mild to moderate heat. Then filter it and consume.
sections.dosage: Take 5 ml of the concentrated kashaya and add 5 ml of luke warm water, mix well, and take orally, two times a day.

fullContent:
Varadi Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam 
 It is also known as Varadi Kashay, Varadi kashayam, Varadi Kasayam etc. 
 Varadi Kashayam is traditional herbal formulation used in Ayurveda for the treatment of urinary disorders, skin diseases and obesity. It has capacity to correct the digestion and metabolism. 
 The meaning of ‘Vara’ is ‘great’ and Kashaya refers to water decoction or herbal tea. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Triphala – (Amla – Emblica officinalis , Haritaki – Terminalia chebula and Vibhitaki –   Terminalia bellirica) 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Loha patra – Iron (Herbal processed Iron foils are kept dipped in the Kashaya for a few days.) A few companies add Loha bhasma (medicated iron ash powder) to it, in place of iron foils) 
 Haridra – Curcuma longa 
 Water 
 
 How to Make? 
 All above mentioned ingredients are immersed in water overnight then next morning, heat it by adding water into it till it is reduced to 1/4th by mild to moderate heat. Then filter it and consume. 
 Dosage 
 Take 5 ml of the concentrated kashaya and add 5 ml of luke warm water, mix well, and take orally, two times a day. 
 Indications 
 
 Heart & Blood 
 High cholesterol levels

 Side Effects 
 In few cases some problems like stomach uneasiness, burning sensation in stomach or lose stools can be seen. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
